messages:
Jordan: Heads up — reconciliation jobs in payments-prod started failing after last night's entitlement sweep. Getting KMS decrypt denied errors. @Sam any idea?
Sam: Saw that. Error from recon service when calling KMS: `PermissionDenied: caller lacks roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
Sam: Looks like the sweep removed the group binding that granted the recon service account access to payments/recon-key.
Maria: We scoped several admin roles during the least-priv audit and flagged payments-prod as high-risk, but I thought we had an exception list for critical keys. If that exception didn't apply, that's on me.
Lina: I can confirm the sweeper ran a bulk RBAC patch at 02:12 UTC (patch eq-2026-03-04T02:12). It applied deletion of some group bindings.
DevOpsBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0324-88 — "payments-recon KMS decrypt failures" — paging #eng-oncall.
Jordan: Short-term mitigation: re-add the cryptoKeyDecrypter binding for the recon service account and validate. Sam, can you share the service account id?
Sam: recon-sa@redwood-prod. Grant command (gcloud):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding recon-key \
  --location global --keyring payments \
  --member serviceAccount:recon-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Lina: I'll test in staging then apply to prod once confirmed.
Jordan: Also need a postmortem for the sweeper. It must not remove KMS grants that are marked service-critical. Assigning follow-up to Maria for sweep config and gate rules.
Maria: Will do. Proposal: pre-sweep check that queries recent key usage (last 30 days) and auto-exempts keys with active service principals above threshold. I'll prototype a query.
Sam: After Lina regranted, ran a dry decrypt: `2026-03-24T02:30:15Z recon: decrypt OK for 1024 msgs`. Jobs recovered, no failures in the last 10m.
Lina: Regrant applied in prod at 02:31 UTC. Audit log entry: grant-by-lina manual-fix.
Jordan: Action items: 1) Lina — PR for rollback runbook and KMS decrypt-rate alert. 2) Maria — sweep gating PR + tests (ETA EOD tomorrow). 3) Sam — add recon key to temporary exception list until gating is in place. 4) Jordan — add review queue mode to sweeper for first 2 weeks post-rollout.
OncallBot: RESOLVED INC-2026-0324-88 — acknowledged by oncall at 02:35 UTC.
Sam: Filed board card SEC-3287 (entitlement-sweep: KMS safeguarding).
Lina: Will post PR links here when ready.
Jordan: Good triage. Leaving this thread open until PRs are linked.
Maria: I'll own the sweep gating PR and acceptance tests.
